parrafo.es: Donnie's Homecook-meal Hines prepara comida jamaiquina autentica en Pompano Beach: oxtail, pescado frito, pollo jerk y mucho mas, con el mismo cuidado de una cocina de casa. Perfecto para cenas familiares, graduaciones y cualquier evento que quieras dejar en manos de alguien de confianza.
parrafo.en: Donnie's Homecook-meal Hines cooks authentic Jamaican food out of Pompano Beach: oxtail, fried fish, jerk chicken and more, with the same care as a home kitchen. Perfect for family dinners, graduations and any event you want handled by someone you can trust.

parrafo_1.es: Donnie's Homecook-meal Hines se dedica a una sola cosa: comida jamaiquina hecha como en casa. Pescado entero, oxtail, pollo frito, pollo jerk y pan dulce, preparados con ingredientes frescos y la receta de siempre.
parrafo_1.en: Donnie's Homecook-meal Hines does one thing: Jamaican food made the way it is at home. Whole fried fish, oxtail, fried chicken, jerk meats and sweet bread, prepared with fresh ingredients and the same recipe every time.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes lo confirman: porciones generosas, calidad constante y un trato cercano en cada pedido, ya sea una cena familiar o un evento grande con servicio completo de catering.
parrafo_2.en: Their clients confirm it: generous portions, consistent quality and a personal touch on every order, whether it is a family dinner or a full-service catered event.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la fecha, el numero de invitados o cuantos platos necesitas. Respuesta directa, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the guest count or how many plates you need. Direct answers, no forms.

texto.es: Oxtail, pescado, pollo frito o jerk: armamos el pedido segun lo que tu o tus invitados prefieran.
texto.en: Oxtail, fish, fried chicken or jerk: we build the order around what you or your guests prefer.

texto.es: Cada plato se prepara el mismo dia, con la misma atencion de una cocina de casa.
texto.en: Every plate is made fresh the same day, with the same care as a home kitchen.

texto.es: Entregamos a domicilio o lo recoges listo, a la hora acordada para tu evento o tu cena.
texto.en: We deliver or have it ready for pickup, right on time for your event or your dinner.

nota.es: Cada pedido se cotiza segun el menu y el numero de invitados. Llamanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Each order is quoted based on the menu and guest count. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: Graduaciones, cumpleanos y reuniones familiares, con montaje tipo buffet y servicio puntual. Llegamos con todo listo para tus invitados.
texto.en: Graduations, birthdays and family gatherings, with buffet-style setup and on-time service. We arrive with everything ready for your guests.

texto.es: Oxtail cocido a fuego lento con zanahoria y frijoles, el plato que mas piden los clientes que repiten.
texto.en: Slow-cooked oxtail with carrots and beans, the dish repeat clients ask for the most.

texto.es: Pescado entero servido con cebolla y pimientos estilo escabeche, ademas de carnes ahumadas con sazon jerk.
texto.en: Whole fried fish served with onions and peppers escovitch-style, plus smoked meats seasoned jerk-style.

texto.es: Pan de frutas y pasteles horneados en casa, el complemento perfecto para cerrar cualquier pedido.
texto.en: Home-baked fruit bread and cakes, the perfect way to round out any order.

pie.es: ¿Tienes un evento con fecha ajustada? Llamanos igual, nos hemos adaptado a pedidos de ultimo momento.
pie.en: Working with a tight date? Call us anyway, we have accommodated last-minute requests before.

items.quote: Donnie's Home Cooked Meals is outstanding! Every meal is fresh, flavorful, and tastes just like a home-cooked meal made with love. The portions are generous, and the quality is always consistent.

WOW!!! I ordered Donnie's for my daughter's college graduation dinner at home and we were all floored with the flavors and quality of the food we received. Donnie is my new go-to for any events and I will recommend him to everyone. He's friendly, has fair pricing and a pleasure to deal with. Thank you Donnie!!

My family & I have ordered from Mr. Donnie many times and it never disappoints! Absolutely amazing catering! The food is fresh, flavorful, and made with so much care, you can truly taste the love in every bite. From presentation to taste, everything was superb.
